blocks.text: Pichhle hisse mein dekha ke electric field mein rakhe charge ke paas kuch electrical potential energy hoti hai. Agar charge q₀ ko charge q ke field mein rakh kar azad chhor dein to q use door dhakel deta hai (dono positive hon to). Eq. (16.17) batati hai ke faasla barhne se potential kam hota hai. Is liye azad positive charge hamesha zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf tez (accelerate) hota hai. Agar in points ka potential difference ΔV ho to charge ki potential energy ΔU = q₀ΔV kam hoti hai, aur yahi kami us ki kinetic energy (motion ki energy) ban jati hai.
Agar charge q₀ wali body (jism) ka mass m ho aur woh kam potential wale point par velocity v se pohanche, to:
Negative charge ulta chalta hai: azad chhoren to woh kam potential se zyada potential ki taraf jata hai.

Eq. (16.18) batati hai ke energy ko charge × potential difference bhi likh sakte hain. Atomic physics mein isi tarah ki energy ki aik unit electron-volt (eV) istemal hoti hai, jo pichhli class mein parh chuke hain. 1 eV woh energy hai jo aik electron 1 volt ke potential difference se tez hone par hasil karta hai.

blocks.text_alt: 1 eV = charge on an electron × 1 volt
